author: machumpo
body:
it looks interesting if you can raise enough points, especially at bestial bond 2 where you get deific channel:

Buff rate 30  
Spell rate 20  
Protect chance 2%

Skills: Yggdrasil's Fury II

Bestial Bond:  
Level 1: Dark Aligned (100%)  
Level 2: Bonded Attack (20%), Bonded Magic (20%), +Ability: Deific Channel  
Level 3: Bonded Defense (20%), Bonded Resistance (20%)

Yggdrasil's Fury II looks ok but I am not a big sigil player so I might be missing something.  But the small skill pool is attractive if you want consistency in what it will cast, especially if you are wearing gear that grants skills to your follower.

Deals holy and dark damage to two opponents with the potential to apply a Dark Sigil. This spell will use either your magic or attack stat, depending on which is greater.  
Targets: A single opponent  
Power: 1500-3000 (x2)  
Costs: 50 mana  
Elements: Dark, Holy  
Causes: Dark Sigil (50%)
